summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) initialized in __init__, set and cleared in run()'s run_app wrapper via try/finally. Added tests/test_concurrency.py with seven tests covering not-running, same-thread, widget access, awaitable callable, exception propagation, exit return value, and call-after-stop. All seven pass when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at the repo's src/ (the venv's textual is installed from base/, so PYTHONPATH is required). Full non-snapshot suite: 68 failures, identical on the untouched base source (missing async pytest plugin in the venv; tests/cli and tests/devtools excluded because aiohttp is absent). Known unfixed race: a call scheduled as the loop finishes could block on a loop that never runs it. Nothing committed.
